process.lead: A clear process with no hidden stages.

1.title: Request
1.text: Choose a service and time online or message us.

2.title: Inspection & quote
2.text: We assess the car and agree the price.

3.text: We do the work in the studio with checks at every stage.

4.title: Handover
4.text: We show you the result and explain aftercare.

1.a: The price depends on vehicle size, paint condition and options. We confirm the exact price after inspection, before any work begins.

2.q: How long does ceramic coating take?
2.a: Usually one to two working days including preparation and polishing. The exact time depends on the number of layers.

3.q: Does the car need polishing before coating or film?
3.a: Yes — a coating locks in the current state of the paint, so we remove defects first.

4.q: Can I leave the car for several days?
4.a: Yes. For long jobs such as film installation, the car stays in the studio for the whole job.

5.q: How do I care for the car after coating?
5.a: At handover we explain which washes to use and when the first wash is safe.

6.a: Online, by phone, or via WhatsApp and Telegram. We'll find a convenient time.
